content:
You can tell for sure whether POP3 or IMAP by looking at <Account Settings | (the account in question) Server Settings>, where it will say "Server Type".

By definition, POP Inbox folders are local folders that are listed with that account in the Folders List Pane. That can be moved elsewhere, though it's not recommended.

Are you sure you're looking at the right Inbox folder? As I said, it's normally located under that account name in the List.

There happens to be a bug in that's recently surfaced in version 155.0 that can cause certain Message Filters to move messages from the Inbox to unexpected destinations. I haven't seen it manifest itself in quite your way, but maybe that's what's happening. If so, an update will be available in a day or two. If you can just sit tight until then, that could fix it.

A related thing to check is to examine all message filters for that account to see if any of them contain a Match condition clause that has a empty blank field. If so, remove that clause or use actual text.
